description_en: Modifies the configuration of a specified VPC
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-vpc-attribute --vpc-id vpc-bp1qtbach57ywecf0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyVpcAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC that you want to modify
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the VPC.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的VPC描述信息。

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the VPC.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的VPC名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: vpc_name

parameters.help_en:
The new IPv4 CIDR block of the VPC.

You can expand or shrink the CIDR block within the original IPv4 CIDR block of the VPC. The recommended subnet mask is 16 to 28 bits. If you shrink the IPv4 CIDR block of the VPC and IP addresses that are already in use fall outside the target CIDR block, the modification fails.

Modifying the IPv4 CIDR block of a VPC does not affect existing services
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的VPC的IPv4网段。

您可以在VPC原IPv4网段内放大或缩小网段，网段掩码推荐使用16~28位。当您缩小VPC的IPv4网段时，如果有已经使用的IP地址在目标网段外，则会修改失败。

修改VPC的IPv4网段，不会影响用户的存量业务
parameters.name: cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
VPC所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable IPv6. Valid values:
false (default): Disabled.
true: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启IPv6。取值：
false（默认值）：关闭。
true：开启
parameters.name: enable_ipv6

parameters.help_en:
The IPv6 CIDR block of the VPC.
When you enable IPv6 for a VPC, the system will assign an IPv6 CIDR block. To specify an IPv6 CIDR block, you need to first invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448916.html operation to reserve the specified IPv6 CIDR block, and then pass it in.
For a VPC that already has IPv6 enabled, you cannot modify the IPv6 CIDR block by passing in this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
VPC的IPv6网段。
为VPC开启IPv6时，系统将分配IPv6网段。如需指定IPv6网段，您需要先调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448916.html接口预留指定的IPv6地址段，并将其传入。
对于已开启IPv6的VPC，无法通过传入本参数来修改IPv6网段
parameters.name: ipv6_cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The type of the IPv6 CIDR block of the VPC. Valid values:

BGP (default): Alibaba Cloud BGP IPv6.
ChinaMobile: China Mobile (single-ISP).
ChinaUnicom: China Unicom (single-ISP).
ChinaTelecom: China Telecom (single-ISP).

If you are a user who has the single-ISP bandwidth whitelist enabled, you can set this parameter to ChinaTelecom (China Telecom), ChinaUnicom (China Unicom), or ChinaMobile (China Mobile)
parameters.help_zh:
VPC的IPv6地址段类型，取值：

BGP（默认值）：阿里云BGP IPv6。
ChinaMobile：中国移动（单线）。
ChinaUnicom：中国联通（单线）。
ChinaTelecom：中国电信（单线）。

如果是开通了单线带宽白名单的用户，该字段可以设置为ChinaTelecom（中国电信）、ChinaUnicom（中国联通）和ChinaMobile（中国移动）
parameters.name: ipv6_isp

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the DNS hostname feature. Valid values:

false (default): Disabled.
true: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用DNS主机名功能。取值：

false（默认值）：不开启。
true：开启
parameters.name: enable_dns_hostname
